text:
Maya: FYI — support case C-12234. Customer signed up via SSO (acme+trial@acme.com) and applied promo code TRIAL2026 but never got the free-trial credits. They’re in ap-southeast-1. No card on file. They’re hitting API errors and say "never received credits". Posting the relevant traces below.

Jon: Can you drop the trace id / redemption logs?

Maya: trace: trace-9f1b. Redeem log excerpt: `billing:promo_redeem account=acct_98765 promo=TRIAL2026 result=failed reason=region_blocked region=ap-southeast-1`

Jon: Hmm — promo service returning region_blocked (403). Was this promo intended to be global?

Maya: Customer thought it was global. Promo was created by growth in Jan. I'll ping them but need a quick fix for the customer.

Priya: I can do a manual grant if we have account id + verification evidence. Also want the audit log for the redemption call.

Maya: acct_98765. Email shows SSO verified. Dashboard shows email_verified=true. Attaching copy of the SSO assertion in the case notes.

Priya: Running manual grant now. Command: 
```
grant-credits --acct acct_98765 --amount 100 --unit trial_credits --reason "manual-support-grant:promo_region_block"
```

infra-bot: action=grant-credits status=success grant_id=grant_12345 amount=100 acct=acct_98765 operator=Priya

Maya: Confirmed with customer — credits now visible and API calls succeed. They can proceed. :white_check_mark:

Jon: Thanks. Please add a reconciliation note to the billing ledger and CC finance. Also open an internal ticket to review promo region rules for TRIAL2026 so this doesn’t recur.

Priya: Will create infra ticket INF-558 to add an allowlist override for verified SSO accounts and to surface promo region mismatch clearly in the UI. Filing it now.

Maya: Case updated with manual grant details and INF-558 link. Notifying growth to verify promo scope. Follow-up: schedule a brief retro with growth and product to confirm promo targeting and communication. :speech_balloon:
